name: 🍛 One-Pot Chicken & Chickpea Curry
tagline: A mild, creamy coconut curry that's family-friendly and on the table in 35 minutes.

items.name: Plain yogurt or Nounos, to serve

steps.text: Heat the oil in a big pot over medium-high. Cook the onion until soft and golden, 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger, curry paste and garam masala; fry 1–2 minutes, stirring, until it smells amazing and darkens a shade.
Add the chicken and a big pinch of salt; stir until coated, 2 minutes.
Pour in half the tomatoes, the coconut milk and chickpeas. Simmer 12–15 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the spinach until wilted. Taste for salt.
Warm the naan in the oven. Serve curry over rice with a spoon of yogurt.

kid_jobs.job: Measure the spices into a little bowl
Stir in the spinach and watch it shrink

chef_tip: Fry the curry paste in the oil for a full 1–2 minutes before anything wet goes in. That 'bloom' is what makes it taste like takeout.
make_ahead: Curry tastes better the next day; make it up to 2 days ahead.
leftovers: Freezes well for 3 months. Leftover tomatoes: freeze or use in chili.
swaps: Sweet potato cubes instead of chickpeas
A spoon of hot sauce for the spice lovers
No paste? 2 Tbsp mild curry powder, bloomed the same way
serve_with: Jasmine rice, warm naan, Nounos yogurt
